questions.q: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin held their first three-way meeting at APEC in which Chinese city?
questions.f: Their joint statement said a nuclear war can never be won and must never be fought.

questions.q: Trump's Asia trip began at the ASEAN summit in which capital city?
questions.f: It was the 49th ASEAN Summit, hosted by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

questions.q: Ukraine brought down part of the road section of which bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea?
questions.f: The bridge had also been hit in October 2022 and July 2023; the Kremlin says it will rebuild.

questions.q: Which country's president, Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, announced his resignation over corruption allegations?
questions.f: He denies the allegations, which relate to a railway contract; parliament must approve the resignation.

questions.q: Israel's Knesset elected a new speaker allied with Gadi Eisenkot. Who?
questions.f: He won 66–52, replacing Netanyahu ally Amir Ohana.

questions.q: Iran fired drones at a US radar in which Gulf state, home to the US Navy's Fifth Fleet?
questions.f: The drones were intercepted; it was the third such attack in five days.

questions.q: A revised COP31 draft deal released on Thursday dropped every reference to what?
questions.f: Australia's Chris Bowen, chairing the talks, vowed to stay until there is consensus.

questions.q: Who was named 2027 Queensland Australian of the Year?
questions.f: His mother Terri accepted the award for him; the national winner is named on 25 January.

questions.q: Which Ipswich sprinter was named Queensland's Young Australian of the Year?
questions.f: Carmel Crouch AM was named Senior Australian of the Year for Queensland.

questions.q: Hailstones about 10 cm across were reported at Mt Tarampa on Monday. Which council area is it in?
questions.f: Hail of 7–8 cm also fell around Gatton and Helidon.

questions.q: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake felt in Darwin and Katherine struck beneath which sea?
questions.f: More than 460 Australians reported feeling it; there was no tsunami threat.

questions.q: In which Brisbane park are early works under way for the 2032 Olympic stadium?
questions.f: The 63,000-seat stadium will host the opening and closing ceremonies and athletics.

questions.q: Australia signed a US-led agreement protecting supply chains for which technology?
questions.f: The deal covers the sensitive technology and inputs that advanced AI depends on.

questions.q: Australia's October unemployment rate was the highest since which year?
questions.f: It was the third monthly rise in a row; employment fell when economists expected a gain.

questions.q: Wages rose 3.5% over the year while inflation is 4.3%. So real wages are doing what?
questions.f: When prices rise faster than pay, what each pay packet buys shrinks.

questions.q: After the jobs data the Australian dollar fell to a 2026 low of about how much?
questions.f: Earlier in November it had been above 70 US cents.

questions.q: Gold fell below which level for the first time since September 2025?
questions.f: It is down about a third from its record near US$5,600 in January.

questions.q: Anthropic, maker of the Claude AI models, listed on Nasdaq under which ticker?
questions.f: It priced at US$83 a share and raised about US$81 billion, a record IPO.

questions.q: SpaceX caught a Starship upper stage for the first time, using tower arms nicknamed what?
questions.f: The booster's own catch was aborted, and it was destroyed over the Gulf of Mexico.

questions.q: A failed Vulcan rocket launch destroyed 40 internet satellites belonging to which company?
questions.f: They were for Amazon's Leo network; it was the first of 38 Vulcan launches Amazon has booked.

questions.q: The US lost its measles elimination status this week. Since which year had it held it?
questions.f: Status is lost when the same strain spreads continuously for 12 months or more.

questions.q: Astronomers watched a giant star swallow a Sun-sized companion in which galaxy?
questions.f: The study, published in Nature, is the first direct observation of such an event.

questions.q: What was Australia's unemployment rate in October?
questions.f: About 44,000 jobs were lost in the month, mostly part-time.

questions.q: By how much did the Wage Price Index rise over the year to September?
questions.f: The 1.1% quarterly rise was the biggest since late 2023.

questions.q: Nvidia's quarterly revenue, its first report since Jensen Huang's exit, was about how much?
questions.f: That was up 103% on a year earlier, and it guided to about US$130 billion next quarter.

questions.q: Queensland's new construction productivity code covers public projects worth more than what?
questions.f: It follows urgent recommendations from the inquiry into the CFMEU.

questions.q: About how many directly employed David Jones staff lose their jobs in the first round of cuts?
questions.f: The figure is 1,689, and the union says only about one in ten was offered redeployment.

questions.q: Tony Burke raised the cap on third-year working holiday visas to what?
questions.f: The cap announced in September was 5,000; places are still handed out by ballot.

questions.q: At APEC, Anthony Albanese planned to raise China's 55% tariff on which Australian export?
questions.f: The tariff applies once China's annual import quota is filled, which happened in June.

questions.q: Jim Chalmers said December's mid-year budget update will include what?
questions.f: He said it would cut enough, but not too much.

questions.q: Victoria's Liberals pledged a youth bootcamp at a former prison near which town?
questions.f: Labor's launch pledged to halve the planned surgery waiting list; Victorians vote on 28 November.

questions.q: What does MYEFO, the mid-year budget update, stand for?
questions.f: It updates the budget forecasts each December.

questions.q: The Trump–Xi–Putin meeting was called a 'trilateral'. How many parties does that mean?
questions.f: It comes from Latin 'tri-' (three) and 'latus' (side).

questions.q: The Leonid meteor shower, which peaked this week, is named after which constellation?
questions.f: Its meteors seem to come from Leo; the shower comes from debris of comet Tempel–Tuttle.

questions.q: Measles is 'endemic' in the US again. The word comes from Greek meaning what?
questions.f: Greek 'en' (in) plus 'dēmos' (people); 'epidemic' is 'upon the people'.

questions.q: In Anthropic's record share listing, what does IPO stand for?
questions.f: An IPO is when a company first sells its shares to the public.

questions.q: The Kangaroos beat New Zealand 32–12 in the World Cup final. What was the winning margin?
The third-year backpacker visa cap went from 5,000 to 25,000. How many times bigger is it?
Anthropic shares were priced at $83 and opened at $111.50. How many dollars higher was the open?
Wages rose 1.1% in the September quarter. How many dollars is 1.1% of an $1,800 weekly wage?
The Kangaroos' win at Suncorp Stadium was their how-manyth straight Rugby League World Cup?
questions.f: The Jillaroos also won a fourth straight title, beating the Kiwi Ferns 34–10.

questions.q: The Wallabies lost 15–12 at Murrayfield to which team?
questions.f: A late Max Jorgensen try wasn't enough; Wales are next on the tour.

questions.q: England clinched their ODI series win over Australia at which ground?
questions.f: Ben Duckett's century set up a 97-run win and a 2–1 series result.

questions.q: Who won golf's DP World Tour Championship in Dubai?
questions.f: Runner-up McIlroy still won an eighth Race to Dubai title, equalling Colin Montgomerie.

questions.q: Which act won seven ARIA Awards, including Album of the Year?
questions.f: Kevin Parker's 'Deadbeat' took Album of the Year at the 40th ARIAs in Sydney.

questions.q: Who won the ARIA for Michael Gudinski Breakthrough Artist?
questions.f: She won four ARIAs on the night.

questions.q: Who set a CMA Awards record with six wins in one night?
questions.f: Her wins included Entertainer of the Year and Song of the Year for 'Choosin' Texas'.

questions.q: GTA VI's Metacritic score of 99 equals the record held by which game?
questions.a: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
questions.f: The game launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November.

questions.q: Johnny Depp had his first US No. 1 opening in eight years with which film?
questions.f: It took an estimated US$19 million, ahead of 'The Cat in the Hat'.

questions.q: In 'Sunrise on the Reaping', Sydney-born Joseph Zada plays the young version of which Hunger Games character?
questions.f: Woody Harrelson played the older Haymitch in the earlier films.
